additional_info.subject: ID0443374-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R9 170002768] Fan issue CRM:00315002909
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, charger v9C6HJ is currently offline in SCB. Please check on-site if the Router is working properly and replace it if necessary. Confirm if the Fans are indeed running at full speed in the logs with Debug mode - if it says Mfan=0 but it still running we need to check this connection:
It's possible that this connector is loose as we already are aware. If the fan is still running at full speed even though it's outputing 0V, then please replace it.
